# Green Max Disposable


Laryngo Pro Medical delivers precision laryngoscopy devices engineered for clinical excellence. Trusted by healthcare providers across Ethiopia, Kenya, and Tanzania for superior airway management and diagnostic accuracy.


Our equipment combines cutting-edge optics with ergonomic design, enabling confident intubation and thorough laryngeal examination in critical care, emergency, and surgical environments.


Request Product Info
Speak with a Specialist



ISO-certified devices meeting international medical standards


Rapid procurement and delivery across East African markets


Comprehensive training and after-sales clinical support


















## Advanced Medical Technology


Our laryngoscopy devices combine precision engineering with intuitive design, delivering exceptional clinical outcomes for healthcare providers across East Africa.









### Clinical Precision


Engineered for optimal visualization with high-definition optics and ergonomic blade design, ensuring accurate intubation in critical care scenarios.








### Rapid Deployment


Pre-sterilized and ready for immediate use, our devices reduce preparation time and streamline emergency response protocols.








### Durability Standards


Medical-grade materials tested for repeated sterilization cycles, maintaining optical clarity and structural integrity throughout extended use.








### Regulatory Compliance


CE-marked and ISO 13485 certified, meeting international quality standards for medical device manufacturing and safety protocols.








### Training Support


Comprehensive clinical education programs and on-site training available for healthcare teams across Ethiopia, Kenya, and Tanzania.








### Regional Distribution


Fast procurement pathways with local inventory hubs ensuring timely delivery and responsive supply chain management for medical facilities.















## Precision in Every Detail


Explore the refined engineering and clinical design of our laryngoscopy solutions. Each component is crafted to deliver optimal visualization, ergonomic handling, and reliable performance in critical airway management procedures.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  1/29/2026



Laryngo Pro Medical ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website www.company.com ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Laryngo Pro Medical

- Email: info@company.com

- Phone: 03-1234567

- Address: Israel



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  January 29, 2026



Laryngo Pro Medical is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Laryngo Pro Medical

- Email: info@company.com

- Phone: 03-1234567



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

## Common questions.





### Do you provide training guidance?


Yes, we offer comprehensive training materials and clinical guidance for all our intubation products. Our team can provide on-site demonstrations, video tutorials, and detailed documentation to ensure your staff feels confident using our medical devices. We work closely with healthcare providers across Ethiopia, Kenya, and Tanzania to deliver tailored training programs.





### How do I choose the right size?


Selecting the appropriate laryngoscope blade size depends on patient anatomy and clinical context. We provide detailed sizing charts and anatomical guidelines with every product shipment. Our medical device specialists are available to consult on product selection for your specific patient population and clinical scenarios.





### Can you share clinical summaries?


Absolutely. We maintain an extensive library of clinical studies, peer-reviewed research, and outcome data for our intubation products. These summaries demonstrate efficacy, safety profiles, and best-practice protocols. Contact our team to request specific clinical documentation relevant to your facility's needs.





### What procurement information do you need?


To expedite your order, we require facility details, product specifications, quantity requirements, and preferred delivery timelines. Our procurement process is designed for efficiency—we work with hospitals, clinics, and distributors throughout East Africa. Provide your institution's registration details and we'll guide you through our streamlined ordering system.





### What is the typical response time?


We prioritize rapid communication for all medical device inquiries. Initial responses are typically provided within 24 hours during business days. For urgent clinical needs or time-sensitive procurement requests, our team offers expedited support channels. Complex technical questions may require 48-72 hours for comprehensive answers from our clinical specialists.





### Do you support international shipping?


Yes, we have established logistics partnerships throughout Ethiopia, Kenya, and Tanzania. Our distribution network ensures reliable delivery of intubation products to both urban medical centers and remote healthcare facilities. We handle all customs documentation and provide tracking for every shipment to guarantee your medical devices arrive safely and on schedule.










## Ready to get clear guidance?


We're here to help you find the right intubation products for your clinical setting. Share your use case and requirements, and our team will provide expert recommendations tailored to your needs across Ethiopia, Kenya, and Tanzania.

## Our company
laryngo pro is a sister concern company of vision medical divices india PVT .LTD
We are Vision Medical Devices (India) Private Limited

Established in the year 2004, Vision Medical Devices India Private Limited is well established manufacturing company specialized in developing Laryngoscope (All type)as per the requirement of medical fraternity (Anaesthetist in Particular). Our Range of Laryngoscopes are constantly upgraded as per feedback from the user to provide them best Laryngoscopes making their lives easier. Our own intensive state- of- art manufacturing unit has helped us maintain the quality of Laryngoscopes and other products with accessories/raw material used/outsourced from the world's best companies. This has helped us attaining prestigious quality certifications including ISO 13485:2016 from BSI UK and CE Confirming to EU declaration. All This has been achieved due to efforts of the company Managing Director Mr. Avi Bhonkar who has tremendous 29 years of past experience of establishing manufacturing unit of Truphatek in India independently
## Advantages
Our Laryngoscopes are well accepted and use in major hospitals in Mumbai, Western & Southern India through our dealers & Distributors. Our Laryngoscopes are approved by Anaesthetist, Intensivists & Bio-Medical Engineers and made available in respective hospitals after complete quality checks conducted by them on their patients .Vision Laryngoscopes are as per ISO standards & anatomically designed as per the need of Anesthetics. Some of the leading names of hospitals where we are serving includes:- 1. Breach Candy Hospital, Mumbai 2. Tata Memorial Hospital, Parel, ACTREC, Tata Memorial Centre, Khargar, Navi Mumbai, 3. Global Hospital, Parel 4. Sir H.N Reliance Foundation Hospital 5. K.D Ambani Hospital 6. Asian Heart Hospital 7. Lilavati Hospital 8. Fortis Hospital. 9 Hinduja Hospital, Mahim. 10. Holly Family Hospital, Seven Hills Hospital, Zen Multispecialty Hospital, Mumbai.
## From Chairman's Desk
It is honor for me to present our company, which outlines our business principals, corporate philosophy, our mission and role we aspire to play in the global market scenario.
Since we ventured into Manufacturing business in 2004, our basic strategy for growth and success has been to reinforce our core business, by continually expanding ,upgrading,diversifying and innovating and to develop new products and business by investing in and conducting intensive R&D backed by extensive market research for in-depth understanding of the market needs. Over the years, we have always kept our customer and his fulfillment our top priority. Our emphasis on pre and post sales service and the penchant for customer satisfaction have earned us as strong base which has been ever growing.This has of course been possible because of our demanding stress on product quality and lowest cost, which has made our name synonymous with high quality products.
A lion's share of this success also goes to my young, enterprising and vibrant team in India, which has completely mesh its identity with the organization image and goals.

Avi Bhonkar
Chairman
Vision Medical Devices India Private Limited.
